name: 量化指纹
description: 分析 JPEG 量化表 fingerprints. Camera images show characteristic quantization 模式 while AI images lack standard compression signatures.
mechanism: 分析 pixel value 直方图s for periodic 模式 caused by JPEG quantization. Camera images show comb-like 模式.
parameters: Periods: 2-8, Metrics: comb ratio, periodic score
useCase: Identifying JPEG压缩 signatures from camera pipelines

references.title: Fan, Z. & de Queiroz, R.L. (2003). Identification of Bitmap Compression History. IEEE ICIP.
Farid, H. (2009). Exposing Digital Forgeries from JPEG Ghosts. IEEE TIFS.
Lukáš, J. et al. (2006). Detecting Digital Image Forgeries Using Sensor Pattern Noise. SPIE.

strengths:
• Directly 分析 JPEG压缩 history
• Can identify specific compression software
• Reveals double compression and editing traces
• Standard 量化表s are well-documented
• Very fast 分析 of DCT 系数
limitations:
• Only applicable to JPEG format
• Custom 量化表s complicate 分析
• Quality factor estimation has inherent uncertainty
• Non-JPEG AI images bypass this 分析
• Re-encoding masks original quantization
